raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 was delivered twice (ingest_ts 02:00 and 05:00) with identical rows, which duplicated every txn_id in it. Raw has 5147 rows but 4814 distinct txn_ids, and the 333 extra rows are exactly half of batch 14's 666. Silver has no dedup, so the duplicates flow into every gold table. The fix is to keep one row per txn_id (latest ingest_ts) before filtering to POSTED.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
